metadata.system: Isle of Dread — Dinosaur Bone crafting (raw harvest: Weapon/Armor/Set-Bonus/Raid)
metadata.note: Raw verbatim effect strings harvested from ddowiki.com/page/Dinosaur_Bone_crafting via Claude-in-Chrome. The Accessory slice shipped earlier (PR #2); this adds the four deferred pools.

recipes.name: Flamescale
recipes.effect: Adds Adamantine material type. On hit: 15d6 Fire Damage.

recipes.name: Icescale
recipes.effect: Adds Cold Iron material type. On hit: 15d6 Cold Damage.

recipes.name: Sparkscale
recipes.effect: Adds Silver material type. On hit: 15d6 Electric Damage.

recipes.name: Meltscale
recipes.effect: Adds Crystal and Byeshk material type. On hit: 15d6 Acid Damage.

recipes.name: Brightscale
recipes.effect:
+9 Enhancement bonus to Spell Penetration. (Bugged, provide Equipment bonus really)
If this is slotted in a Quarterstaff, also grants a +2 Exceptional bonus to Spell DCs and makes the Quarterstaff an Implement.

recipes.name: Shadowscale
recipes.effect:
+10% Enhancement bonus to Spell Cost Reduction.
If this is slotted in a Quarterstaff, also grants a +2 Exceptional bonus to Spell DCs and makes the Quarterstaff an Implement.

recipes.name: Iridiscent Scale
recipes.effect:
+102 Equipment bonus to all Spellpowers.
If this is slotted in a Quarterstaff, also grants a +2 Exceptional bonus to Spell DCs and makes the Quarterstaff an Implement.

recipes.name: Flamefang
recipes.effect:
Adds Good alignment bypass. Your attacks and spells have a small chance to deal a large amount of Fire damage.
(undocumented) (Grants Alchemical Fire Attunement)

recipes.name: Icefang
recipes.effect:
Adds Chaotic alignment bypass. Your attacks and spells have a chance to inflict ten stacks of Cold damage over time.
(undocumented) (Grants Alchemical Water Attunement)

recipes.name: Sparkfang
recipes.effect:
Adds Lawful alignment bypass. Your attacks and spells have a small chance to deal a massive amount of Electric damage.
(undocumented) (Grants Alchemical Air Attunement)

recipes.name: Meltfang
recipes.effect:
Adds Evil alignment bypass. Your attacks and spells deal a large amount of stacking Acid damage over time.
(undocumented) (Grants Alchemical Earth Attunement)

recipes.name: Brightfang
recipes.effect:
Your attacks and offensive spells have a chance to deal Untyped damage.
(undocumented) (Grants Legendary Steam)

recipes.name: Shadowfang
recipes.effect:
Your attacks and offensive spells have a chance to apply a Curse that deals significant Untyped damage over time.
(undocumented) (Untyped damage DOT with 6d6+6 damage every 2 seconds for 12 sec, consecutive attacks extend duration to 1 min 25 sec)

recipes.name: Iridiscent Fang
recipes.effect:
+7 Equipment bonus to all Spell DCs.
If this is slotted in a Quarterstaff, also grants a +5% Exceptional bonus to Spell Critical Chance and makes the Quarterstaff an Implement.

recipes.name: Flameclaw
recipes.effect: +2 Exceptional bonus to Strength.

recipes.name: Iceclaw
recipes.effect: +2 Exceptional bonus to Wisdom.

recipes.name: Sparkclaw
recipes.effect: +2 Exceptional bonus to Charisma.

recipes.name: Meltclaw
recipes.effect: +2 Exceptional bonus to Constitution.

recipes.name: Brightclaw
recipes.effect: +2 Exceptional bonus to Intelligence.

recipes.name: Shadowclaw
recipes.effect: +2 Exceptional bonus to Dexterity.

recipes.name: Iridiscent Claw: Acid
recipes.effect: +149 Equipment bonus to Acid Spellpower.

recipes.name: Iridiscent Claw: Cold
recipes.effect: +149 Equipment bonus to Cold Spellpower.

recipes.name: Iridiscent Claw: Electric
recipes.effect: +149 Equipment bonus to Electric Spellpower.

recipes.name: Iridiscent Claw: Fire
recipes.effect: +149 Equipment bonus to Fire Spellpower.

recipes.name: Iridiscent Claw: Force
recipes.effect: +149 Equipment bonus to Force and Physical Spellpower.

recipes.name: Iridiscent Claw: Light
recipes.effect: +149 Equipment bonus to Light and Alignment Spellpower.

recipes.name: Iridiscent Claw: Negative
recipes.effect: +149 Equipment bonus to Negative and Poison Spellpower.

recipes.name: Iridiscent Claw: Positive
recipes.effect: +149 Equipment bonus to Positive Spellpower.

recipes.name: Iridiscent Claw: Repair
recipes.effect: +149 Equipment bonus to Repair Spellpower.

recipes.name: Iridiscent Claw: Sonic
recipes.effect: +149 Equipment bonus to Sonic Spellpower.

recipes.name: Flamehorn
recipes.effect:
Your attacks and offensive spells have a chance to reduce enemy Magical Resistance Rating and Universal Spell Power.
(undocumented) (Grants Legendary Ash)

recipes.name: Icehorn
recipes.effect:
Your attacks and offensive spells have a chance to freeze your target in a block of ice.
(undocumented) (Grants Legendary Ice)

recipes.name: Sparkhorn
recipes.effect:
Your attacks and offensive spells have a chance to inflict multiple stacks of Vulnerability.
(undocumented) (Grants Legendary Vacuum)

recipes.name: Melthorn
recipes.effect:
Your attacks and offensive spells have a chance to reduce enemy Physical Resistance Rating and Positive Healing Amplification.
(undocumented) (Grants Legendary Dust)

recipes.name: Brighthorn
recipes.effect:
Your attacks and offensive spells have a chance to grant you 1,000 Temporary HP.
(undocumented) (Grants Legendary Affirmation)

recipes.name: Shadowhorn
recipes.effect:
Your attacks and offensive spells have a chance to reduce enemy Physical and Magical Resistance Rating.
(undocumented) (Grants a version of Constricting Nightmare that works with spells)

recipes.name: Bronzescale
recipes.effect: You have Deathblock and are Ghostly.

recipes.name: Goldscale
recipes.effect: +150% Enhancement bonus to Fortification.

recipes.name: Silverscale
recipes.effect:
+56 Competence bonus to Positive Healing Amplification
+56 Enhancement bonus to Repair Healing Amplification
+56 Profane bonus to Negative Healing Amplification

recipes.name: Voidscale
recipes.effect: +5% Exceptional bonus to Universal Spell Lore

recipes.name: Goldfang
recipes.effect: +2d6 Profane bonus to your Sneak Attack Dice.

recipes.name: Silverfang
recipes.effect: +2 Profane bonus to Spell DCs, Tactical DCs, and Assassinate.

recipes.name: Voidfang
recipes.effect: +15 Exceptional bonus to Potency.

raid.name: Aspect of Tar
raid.effect:
Your attacks and offensive spells have a chance to reduce enemy PRR and MRR and summon Tar oozes to your aid.
(Grants Legendary Ooze but summons a CR 52 Tar Bubble)

raid.name: Black Sands' Desire
raid.effect:
Your attacks and offensive spells have a chance to significantly slow your enemies.
(Grants limited version of Legendary Salt, provide 1 stack instead 8)

raid.name: Fragment of Extraplanar Alignment
raid.effect: +23% Enhancement bonus to Alignment absorption, which includes Law, Chaos, Good, and Evil damage.

raid.name: Fragment of Extraplanar Shadow
raid.effect: +3% Profane Doublestrike and Doubleshot, +15% Enhancement bonus to Melee Alacrity, +20% Enhancement bonus to Ranged Alacrity.

raid.name: Fossilized Amber
raid.effect: +250 Unconsciousness Range. You heal 20 HP every minute from Positive Energy.
